§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Keep a Large Steam Furnace controller in your inventory to complete this item check; §2the items are not consumed§r. The furnace processes smelting recipes with steam; tier and recipe affect its throughput and supply needs. Check the controller tooltip before planning upgrades.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
This check establishes controller possession, not structure validity, recipe execution, or current steam supply. List the production jobs to move from existing smelting equipment, then choose buses and output handling for the tier. Before starting, verify the recipe and steam inlet, especially after increasing parallelism, so blocked output is not mistaken for a supply problem.
